selection.summary: Issue asks to add pretty printing for DOM JSON. Evidence delivered: include/simdjson/dom/serialization-inl.h (current source) showing the existing serialization machinery: parser::print_json, the string_builder usage, escape_sequence handling, and fast_itoa helpers. These are the base components a pretty-print implementation (indentation with fixed four spaces, plus documentation) would build on in the DOM serialization layer.
